user.title: Choose a connection mode
user.description: External bridge mode remains the production fallback. Embedded mode currently validates Owlet cloud access and camera credentials only.

embedded.title: Embedded experimental cloud validation
embedded.description: This validates Owlet authentication and camera KMS metadata. Native streaming is not started.

data_description.camera_dsn: Use the serial shown in the Owlet app or printed on the camera. The integration discovers any different internal KMS identifier without displaying it.
data_description.password: Stored in Home Assistant config-entry data and never written to runtime files.

external.title: Connect to an Owlet bridge
external.description: Connect to the current btoth525/Owlet-To-Rtsp HTTP API. The integration ignores camera credentials returned by that bridge and requests room temperatures in Celsius.

external_camera.title: Select a camera
external_camera.description: Choose the bridge camera to add as one Home Assistant device.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Owlet Cam
reauth_confirm.description: Enter valid Owlet account credentials for this camera.

reauth_bridge.title: Reauthenticate Owlet bridge
reauth_bridge.description: Enter valid API credentials for the existing external bridge camera.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Owlet Cam
reconfigure.description: Revalidate the account and existing camera DSN. To add another camera, create another entry.

reconfigure_bridge.title: Reconfigure Owlet bridge
reconfigure_bridge.description: Revalidate the existing camera against updated bridge connection settings.

data.bridge_password: Optional replacement API password or token

general.title: General
general.description: Configure general update and future media behavior.

data_description.idle_disconnect_timeout: Seconds before a future idle embedded session disconnects.
data_description.update_interval: Cloud status update interval in seconds.

embedded.title: Embedded experimental
embedded.description: These settings are stored now and take effect as native runtime milestones become available.

data_description.prefer_direct_p2p: Observation only until testing proves that relay mode causes failures.

external.title: External bridge
external.description: Configure bridge polling and an optional replacement RTSP source.

missing_apk.title: Owlet application is required
missing_apk.description: Open the Owlet Cam Runtime panel and upload your own Owlet APK, APKM, XAPK, or ZIP package.

missing_arm64_split.title: ARM64 Owlet application split is missing
missing_arm64_split.description: Upload a package that includes the arm64-v8a application split.

missing_library.title: A required native library is missing
missing_library.description: Upload a complete current Owlet application package and run the runtime probe again.

missing_sdk_key.title: Owlet SDK key was not found
missing_sdk_key.description: The supplied application does not contain the required SDK material. Try a complete current package.

unsupported_architecture.title: Embedded Owlet runtime is unsupported on this architecture
unsupported_architecture.description: Embedded mode currently requires AArch64. Use external bridge mode on this machine.

library_incompatible.title: Owlet native libraries are incompatible
library_incompatible.description: The supplied libraries failed an ARM64 ELF or symbol compatibility gate. External bridge mode remains available.

invalid_apk.title: Owlet application package is invalid
invalid_apk.description: The uploaded package failed archive safety or content validation. Upload a complete unmodified package.

invalid_extracted_files.title: Stored Owlet application files are invalid
invalid_extracted_files.description: Delete proprietary files in the Owlet Cam Runtime panel, upload the package again, and rerun the runtime probe.

invalid_runtime_manifest.title: Owlet helper runtime verification failed
invalid_runtime_manifest.description: The open-source helper runtime failed its manifest or checksum gate. Reinstall the matching integration release.

invalid_runtime_storage.title: Owlet runtime storage is unsafe
invalid_runtime_storage.description: An integration-owned runtime directory is missing, replaced, or symlinked. Restore the Owlet Cam userfiles directory and rerun validation.

runtime_checksum_mismatch.title: Owlet helper checksum verification failed
runtime_checksum_mismatch.description: The open-source helper does not match its pinned checksum. Reinstall the matching integration release; it will not be executed.

runtime_download_failed.title: Owlet helper download failed
runtime_download_failed.description: The exact open-source helper for this integration version could not be downloaded or installed. Check internet access and the matching GitHub release, then run the runtime probe again.

missing_runtime.title: Owlet helper runtime is missing
missing_runtime.description: Install the helper runtime matching this integration version before running an embedded probe.

obsolete_helper_runtime.title: Owlet helper runtime is obsolete
obsolete_helper_runtime.description: Install the helper runtime pinned to this integration release before continuing embedded operation.

runtime_state_write_failed.title: Owlet runtime state could not be saved
runtime_state_write_failed.description: Check available storage and filesystem health, then rerun the runtime probe.

reauthentication_required.title: Owlet reauthentication is required
reauthentication_required.description: Open the Owlet Cam integration and complete its reauthentication flow.

stream_recovery_failed.title: Owlet stream recovery repeatedly failed
stream_recovery_failed.description: Review redacted diagnostics and system logs, then use Restart stream in the Owlet Cam Runtime panel.
